messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: Starlit Health sent an RFP. They want an RFI + 3-week POC focused on embeddings search accuracy + 95th pct latency. Asks: POC timeline, POC pricing for ~25M gen tokens + 3M embeddings, KMS/HSM details, and a capability matrix. Can SE/sec/sre sync quick?

Evan (SE): On it. Proposed POC plan: week1 ingest & mapping, week2 tuning + Dedicated pool, week3 acceptance and handover. Need anonymized sample data, SSO test account, and acceptance criteria (recall@10, p95 < 180ms). Who owns the capability_matrix doc?

Maya (AE): I'll draft the matrix and send initial answers. Quick pricing sense? They asked about a POC discount too.

Evan (SE): Planning numbers: gen $0.0006/token, embeddings $0.00085/embed. For a 3-week pilot offer: 35% POC discount on committed usage or a fixed cap. Recommend Dedicated for predictable tail latency testing.

Kai (Security): Security RFI items: CMK support, HSM for on-prem, audit logging, SOC2 evidence, and data residency. Suggested short blurb: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private/on-prem deployments we support HSM integrations and do not export customer private key material. Audit logs for admin and access events can be retained per contract (standard 90 days, extensions available)."

Jordan (SRE): We have a 2-GPU Dedicated pool available in us-west-2 during their window. Suggest autoscale min=1 max=3. I'll reserve and post a compact runbook (deploy steps, metrics to capture, escalation path). Will also add cost-tracking tags.

Maya (AE): Actions: I will upload capability_matrix_draft and send to Starlit. Evan finalize RFI answers, Kai provide SOC2/KMS links and one-paragraph HSM wording, Jordan reserve pool + runbook.

POC-bot: Ticket created POC-4920 and assigned to Evan (SE). Due date: 1739020000.

Evan (SE): I'll update the ticket when the RFI bundle is ready. If anyone has short, legal-friendly HSM phrasing, paste here. :thumbsup:

Kai (Security): Dropping links (contract access): https://vault.redwood/soc2/redacted and https://vault.redwood/kms-guide. I'll DM contracts about POC addendum language.

Maya (AE): Thanks all  aiming to send the full RFI+POC proposal to Starlit by tomorrow 09:00 PT.
